craft_notes: Sthāyin: unbroken-gaze (stabdhātmā — the stunned self). Rows: row 3 (moment→form won). Close: won (#4 winning-verb — the block counts wins: fortune, flood, freedom, form). Rejected: 'freezes' — killed: stunned kept (stabdha as held, not stopped); 'Bhairavī-form' — killed: Bhairava-form kept (his form is won).

lines: Sky stainless, seeing: gaze unbroken made:
stunned self, that moment — Bhairava form won.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ākāśaṃ vimalam paśyan kṛtvā dṛṣṭiṃ nirantarām | stabdhātmā tatkṣaṇād devi bhairavaṃ vapur āpnuyāt

reads_against.argmap: What is won by unbroken gaze? → The unbroken gaze stuns the self — Bhairava-form is won at that moment.
c1_essence: Unbroken sky-gaze: stunned self wins Bhairava-form.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta (stillness startled by its own gates)
